instruction.text: Before people began to explore space, there were lots of theories about the Moon. Match the theory to the picture.

b.sound: Some legends said that a rabbit lived on the Moon.
Some people thought that aliens lived on the Moon.
Some people thought the Moon was made out of cheese.

instruction.text: Draw a line between the Earth and the Moon.

feedback.finish: After World War II, the USA and the USSR competed with each other to be the first country to explore space. This was called the Space Race.

hint.label: USSR
hint.text: The USSR stands for the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics. The USSR no longer exists because it was split into lots of different countries in 1991.

feedback.finish: The USSR were winning the Space Race at the beginning because they were first to launch someone into space.

hint.label: Cosmonaut
hint.text: A cosmonaut is what people in the USSR called an astronaut.

atoms.b: Yuri Gagarin was the first ((++human dolphin)) in space. He was a cosmonaut from the USSR.
In 1961, Gagarin flew in his rocket — Vostok 1 — and spent 108 minutes in ((++space jelly)).

instruction.text: Select the president of the USA, John F. Kennedy, to find out about his plan for the Space Race in 1962.

atoms.sound: We choose to go to the Moon.

feedback.finish: After the USSR had put a human in space, Kennedy was determined that the USA would be first to step foot on the Moon.
